reviewed_by: Codex evidence review and independent read-only critic /root/review_divergence_patch, 2026-10-20
scope: Retained static branches and controlled masked-exception x86 state fixtures. Provisional integration, not universal equivalence.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Exact retail entry, single selected Binary Ninja view and Radare2 graphs agree; angr independently recovers the entry.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Independent critic confirmed stack interfaces: no stack x87control parameter; 0x004AC66B uses the low16 bits of its stack input. Prototype names remain inferred.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Masks, bit translations, AH byte writes, precision defaults and denormal-mask filtering match the retained retail instructions. No gameplay constants were introduced.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: FPU initialization saves the two-byte control word to the mapped global; other leafs read/change x87 state or convert scalar flags. Replay checks adjacent global bytes.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: The recovered precision initializer retains the original call chain and input/mask constants. Pure conversion functions do not touch floating state. Independent critic found no concrete mismatch.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Replay compares defined scalar returns, callee-saved registers, x87 control/status and mapped memory. The rounding initializer has no defined C return and preserves the observed incidental registers.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: 64 concrete x86 cases passed across six entries, including16 scalar boundary cases per conversion function. Pending exceptions, unmasked traps and live x87 stack payloads remain outside this scope.

limits: Pending exceptions, unmasked traps, live x87 stack payloads and all arbitrary control-word/flag combinations are unverified.
Broader arithmetic, player simulation, graphics, camera and materials are not verified by these leaf tests.
The runtime world probe observes initialization state; it does not establish paired identical-input coverage for every leaf.
